headline: Operating profit surges far above last year
summary_short: Revenue was KRW 11.97T, up 42.2% y/y, and operating profit was KRW 1.41T, up 513.7% y/y. Yahoo EPS was KRW 12,331 against KRW 543 a year ago.
summary_long: Third-party coverage of the results reports operating profit about 18% above a KRW 1.19T consensus. By segment, refining and lubricants were profitable and petrochemicals posted a small operating loss. Reported net profit was KRW 1.44T against KRW 871.9B. No drivers or guidance are assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Figures come from search-result snippets of third-party coverage. Sources disagree on revenue growth (42.2% in two sources, 5.5% in one); 42.2% is shown. EPS is Yahoo data and the large y/y change comes from a very low base.
